title: 6.8 — TMA initData HMAC Validation
description:
## Subtasks
- [ ] Middleware: validate initData on every request
- [ ] HMAC-SHA256: secret = HMAC-SHA256('WebAppData', botToken), hash = HMAC-SHA256(secret, checkString)
- [ ] Validation: compare computed hash with initData hash param
- [ ] Auth date check: reject if older than 24 hours
- [ ] Extract user data: id, first_name, username, language_code
- [ ] Guard: @TelegramAuth() decorator
- [ ] Test: mock initData + validate

**Soat:** 4h | **Prio:** P0
**Output:** Secure TMA initData validation (HMAC)

title: 5.4 — BullMQ Delayed Jobs Setup
description:

- [ ] RemindersQueue: delayed jobs for each reminder

- [ ] Job options: removeOnComplete: { count: 100 }, removeOnFail: { count: 50 }
- [ ] jobId = reminder.id (idempotent — duplicate prevention)
- [ ] Repeatable jobs: BullMQ repeatable for recurring reminders
- [ ] Job recovery: on restart, sync pending jobs from DB
- [ ] Worker concurrency: 10, rate limit: 100/sec
- [ ] Rate limit per user: max 30 reminders/month (free tier)

**Soat:** 8h | **Prio:** P0
**Output:** Reliable BullMQ delayed job system for reminders

description:

- [ ] Query: birthdays WHERE EXTRACT(MONTH FROM birthDate) = current_month AND EXTRACT(DAY FROM birthDate) = current_day
- [ ] Query: birthdays WHERE birthDate = CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days' (7-day reminder)
- [ ] Query: birthdays WHERE birthDate = CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '3 days' (3-day reminder)
- [ ] Query: birthdays WHERE birthDate = CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day' (1-day reminder)
- [ ] Result → pg_notify('birthday_alert', payload) → BullMQ notification job
- [ ] Worker: send birthday message per family member

**Soat:** 6h | **Prio:** P1
**Output:** Daily automated birthday checks + reminders
